map.根据肤质、年龄定制你的专属护肤流程: Build your own skincare routine from your skin type and age
map.第一步：测试你的肤质: Step one: test your skin type
map.温和清洁，避免过度清洁破坏屏障: Cleanse gently and avoid over-cleansing that damages the barrier
map.二次清洁、补水、打开吸收通道: Second cleansing, hydration, opens the absorption path
map.功效性产品，分子小先涂: Efficacy product, small molecules go on first
map.眼周肌肤薄，需要专门护理: Eye area skin is thin and needs dedicated care
map.保湿锁水，封住前面的营养: Hydrate and seal in the nutrients applied before
map.白天最后一步，抗老的关键: The last step of the day, the key to anti-aging
map.水 → 精华 → 眼 → 乳 → 霜 → 防晒: Water → serum → eye → lotion → cream → sunscreen
map.质地从稀到稠，分子从小到大。先涂水质，再涂油质。: Go from thin to thick texture, and from small to large molecules. Apply water-based products first, then oil-based.
map.❌ 不能一起用的成分: ❌ Ingredients that should not be combined
map.水杨酸+果酸、水杨酸+维A醇 = 过度去角质，屏障受损: Salicylic acid + glycolic acid, salicylic acid + retinol = over-exfoliation and barrier damage
map.A醇+果酸/水杨酸 = 刺激性翻倍，容易泛红脱皮: Retinol + glycolic or salicylic acid = double the irritation, easy redness and peeling
map.高浓度原型VC（pH<3.5）+烟酰胺 = 可能转化为烟酸刺激皮肤: High-strength L-ascorbic acid (pH below 3.5) + niacinamide may convert to niacin acid and irritate the skin
map.蓝铜胜肽遇到维C会被氧化失活: Blue copper peptide is oxidised and inactivated when it meets vitamin C
map.酶类去角质成分在强酸环境下失活: Enzymatic exfoliating ingredients are inactivated in a strong acid environment
map.• 早C晚A（但需建立耐受）: • Vitamin C in the morning, retinol at night (but build tolerance first)
map.• 玻尿酸 + 任何成分（百搭补水）: • Hyaluronic acid + any ingredient (universally mixable hydrator)
map.黄豆到花生米大小: From a soybean to a peanut-sized blob
map.浸透化妆棉/一元硬币: Soak a cotton pad or a one-yuan coin
map.一元硬币大小（全脸）: One-yuan-coin sized for the whole face
map.⚠️ 用量不足等于白用！尤其是防晒，涂不够量完全没有防护效果。: ⚠️ Too little product means wasted product, especially sunscreen: apply too little and you get no protection at all.
map.📚 深度解析：个性化护肤流程规划: 📚 In-depth analysis: personalized skincare routine planner
map.按肤质与年龄生成从洁面到防晒的步骤顺序。: Generate the step order from cleansing to sunscreen for your skin type and age.
map.护肤步骤太多，想理清先后与搭配原则。: Too many skincare steps and you want to clarify the order and the pairing principles.
map.顾问给客户一份可复制的日常流程。: An advisor gives the client a copyable daily routine.
map.干皮晨晚流程算例: Dry skin morning and evening example
map.干性 30 岁：晨间温水洁面→保湿水→精华（玻尿酸）→面霜→防晒；夜间卸妆→洁面: For a 30-year-old with dry skin: morning lukewarm water cleanse, hydrating toner, serum (hyaluronic acid), cream, sunscreen; evening makeup removal, cleanse, toner, serum, eye cream, cream as a sealing layer. Principles: water-based before oil-based, small molecules before large ones, and sunscreen as the irreplaceable last daytime step.
map.精华和面霜顺序能反吗？: Can serum and cream be swapped?
map.不建议。精华小分子先渗透，面霜大分子后锁水；先霜后精华会阻碍吸收，且面霜油脂阻隔: Not recommended. Small-molecule serum penetrates first and large-molecule cream locks water in afterwards; cream before serum blocks absorption, and the cream's oils also block water-soluble ingredients.
map.步骤越多越好吗？: Is more always better when it comes to steps?
map.不是。步骤多易叠加刺激、增加成本；以清洁-保湿-防晒为基础，功效精华按需求 1–: No. More steps stack irritation and raise cost. Start from cleanse, hydrate and sunscreen, then add one or two efficacy serums to suit your needs; sensitive skin is safer going minimal.
map.护肤步骤规划。美容护肤工具，帮助计算护肤品用量与配比。: Skincare step planner. A beauty and skincare tool that helps calculate product dosage and mixing ratios.
